patch.value: Adopt an atomic SDK close with fenced metadata changes

Pinned PmClient.update auto-routes terminal status plus field/unset changes into a metadata update followed by a separate native close. CloseCommandOptions has no atomic custom-field/unset patch. Swarm now admits and compares every native commit and advances its expected snapshot only from the exact SDK onWrite successor; a later refusal reports committed native steps rather than claiming rollback. This preserves privacy and peer state, but does not establish a single-commit or all-or-nothing crash contract for compound close. Adopt a public SDK atomic guarded close when available; do not rebuild lifecycle/history behavior or compensate over foreign edits.

One guarded native item commit for close plus fencing fields and cleanup; interleaving and crash injection at every native transition; no lost peer changes or duplicate history; retain typed partial-state remedies until the SDK capability is available.
